question_text: Outline how a track sensor and processor can update a station display when a train passes the sensor.
adaptation_rationale: Removes unsupported GPS technical requirements; retains input–process–output reasoning from the original sensor part.
solution: The sensor produces input indicating passage at a known position. The processor uses that new input to revise the predicted arrival time and sends the result to the display.

marking_points.criterion: Processor updates output from the new sensor data.
